summary: A mature, well-tested library with almost no written delivery process. Its CI runs a nine-leg test matrix, the linter and a link checker on every pull request, but main is unprotected, so none of it can stop a merge. There is no agent instruction file, no hooks and no written release process; product documentation is excellent, and nothing derived is committed.

profile.why: Two maintainers, one package, no deploy environments: Solo/Lite asks for the three practices a repository of this size gains most from, and nothing it would have to staff.

read: package.json, .npmrc and the test, lint and type scripts
readme.md, docs/ and the files under .github/
the last 100 merged pull requests and their reviews
the branch and rulesets endpoints of the repository host

unchecked.why: the protection endpoint needs admin rights; the branch endpoint said protected: false and the rulesets endpoint returned none.

stack.detected: JavaScript (ESM) with hand-written TypeScript declarations; Node 22 or later
npm, without a lockfile; npm scripts
GitHub Actions, one workflow, three operating systems by three Node versions

recommendations.title: Make the existing CI a merge gate
recommendations.finding: main is unprotected, and the workflow runs lint and the link check only on the ubuntu, Node 26 leg of the matrix.
recommendations.action: Move lint and the link check into their own always-run job, then require that job and the test matrix on main with a ruleset.

recommendations.title: Write down the gate set and the release steps
recommendations.finding: npm test is the gate set, but no document says so; releases are visible only as version commits and tags.
recommendations.action: Add a short AGENTS.md that names npm test as the gate set, the habit of adding a regression test with every fix, and the release steps.

recommendations.title: Pin the workflow's actions and keep them updated
recommendations.finding: Every uses: line names a mutable major tag, and there is no Dependabot or Renovate configuration.
recommendations.action: Pin each action to a commit hash and add .github/dependabot.yml for github-actions.
recommendations.lighter: Pin the actions to commit hashes by hand now, and add the updater when the workflow starts to change often.

recommendations.title: Name the whole local check in the Jig configuration
recommendations.finding: npm run test runs lint, the unit tests and the type tests in one command.
recommendations.action: Set gates.command: npm run test in .config/jig.yaml, so the review and CI skills run it before every push.

recommendations.title: Record why the toolchain changed
recommendations.finding: The switch from ava to node:test left no rationale: the commit is titled Tweaks.
recommendations.action: Start a docs/decisions/ folder with a numbered template and record the test-runner decision as its first entry.
recommendations.lighter: Write the reason for the next toolchain change in its pull request description, with no decision-record files.

drift.text: The test runner is node --test under c8, not ava as the earlier hand-run audit says; the switch left no rationale.
The coverage service waits for 6 uploads while the matrix now uploads 9.
npm test and CI run different sets: CI adds the link check, and lint runs on every machine locally but on one leg in CI.

terms.meaning: A check that must pass before a pull request can merge.
One combination of operating system and Node version that the CI workflow runs.
